description: List templates, commands, contacts, groups or time periods by name, sorted by name, to find the exact name another tool needs. The total counts every match; items lists the first. Use it for "which service templates exist for disks" or "what is the host group of tenant X called".

kind.description: Which kind of configuration object to list.

limit.description: How many objects to list. The total always covers every match.

name.description: Part of the name. Empty: every object of the kind.

name: list_catalog
title: Configuration Catalog
